@@U04560@@
treasure gives him no pleasure. Sadness, gladness are a whim, he starves amidst his plenty, and pain and rapture are both postponed, for only the future has his interest, and nothing is ever accomplished.

@@U04562@@
Stop! Youll never get to me that way! I won't hear such nonsense! Leave here! This litany of yours might deceive the wisest of men! It won't deceive me!

@@U04564@@
Shall he go? Shall he come? He simply can’t make up his mind. Midway in the beaten path he gropes and staggers, step at a time, growing ever more confused, sees the world about him whirling, a burden to himself and others, who, breathing, takes a breath and smothers; no, not smothers, not quite dead yet. Never yielding nor despairing, he rolls on down his endless incline, resigning everything delightful, doing what he deathly hates, sleeping badly, badly waking, pinned to the spot that makes him ready to suffer eternal hellish perdition.

@@U04566@@
Cursed specters! This is how you've treated the human race time out of mind! Even indifferent days you turn into tangles of ensnaring torment!
translation:
@@U04560@@
财宝不会给他带来快乐。悲伤、快乐都是一时兴起，他在富足中挨饿，痛苦和狂喜都被推迟，因为他只关心未来，而什么也没有完成。

@@U04562@@
停下来！你永远不会那样接近我！我不会听这样的废话！离开这里！你的这番长篇大论可能会欺骗最聪明的人！它不会骗我的！

@@U04564@@
他要走吗？他会来吗？他就是拿不定主意。在人迹罕至的道路中途，他摸索着，摇摇晃晃，一步一步，变得越来越困惑，看到他周围的世界在旋转，对他自己和其他人来说都是一种负担，他们呼吸，呼吸，窒息；不，没有窒息，还没有完全死掉。他从不屈服，也不绝望，沿着无尽的斜坡滚下去，放弃一切令人愉快的事情，做他极其讨厌的事情，睡不好，醒得不好，被钉在一个让他准备遭受永恒地狱般的灭亡的地方。

@@U04566@@
被诅咒的幽灵！你们就是这样对待人类的！连淡漠的日子也变成了缠绵的折磨！
